name: Kubernetes Orchestration & Helm Integration
description: Integration pack for Kubernetes API and Helm Package Manager, providing connectivity to Kubernetes cluster API endpoints, ServiceAccount token authentication, Helm chart deployments, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), and pod status rollout tracking.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Kubernetes namespaces, Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, and Persistent Volume Claims (PVC).

capabilities.name: Production Deployment & Release Management
capabilities.description: Integrates Helm release upgrades, rolling deployment rollouts, canary releases, and release rollbacks.

checklists.name: Kubernetes Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Kubernetes ServiceAccount RBAC permissions, Helm release values, and pod readiness probes.

items.statement: Kubernetes ServiceAccount RBAC Role / ClusterRole binds least-privilege permissions for target namespaces.
Helm release deployments pass helm lint and validate custom values.yaml schemas.
Deployment rollout status (kubectl rollout status) confirms all pod readiness probes pass within timeout limits.

reviewGates.name: Kubernetes Infrastructure Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Container Platform Lead confirms that Kubernetes ServiceAccount RBAC and Helm release deployments operate properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Kubernetes integration verify cluster API authentication and Helm release rollout status?
